scope: Independent source and focused-test review of the D87 baseline Settings-shell failure diagnostic. This is not a native product acceptance result.

findings.failure_gate: The caller runs capture only when failureCode(error) is exactly d87_settings_shell_not_observed. A focused test exercises matching and unrelated failures; the operation is set to settings_shell before the shell wait can fail.
findings.diagnostic_data: Target IDs and panel URLs are used only for in-memory equality checks. The emitted snapshot contains Booleans and bounded counts; the tests confirm owned, replacement, and unobserved cases and check that fixture IDs/URLs do not appear in output.
findings.acceptance_effect: The catch-path diagnostic does not mark a case passed or alter the acceptance status. It only enriches failure evidence; no D87/D0189 or Settings product credit follows.

forcing_evidence.caller_gate: The implementer reports an executed plant.py mutation disabling the exact-code gate; the matching-vs-unrelated test went RED and the source was restored byte-identically.
forcing_evidence.collector: The implementer reports an executed plant.py constant-result collector mutation; the owned-vs-replacement test went RED and the source was restored byte-identically.

verification.biome: Biome check passes on all three reviewed paths
verification.diff_check: git diff --check passes on all three reviewed paths
